text:
Type: round glazed ceramic bud vase
Use: holding a few stems; living room, dining room, bedroom, on a table, shelf or windowsill
Style: mid-century modern, bohemian, retro
Materials: ceramic with reactive drip glaze, crystalline speckles
Colors: turquoise, cobalt blue, olive green
Shape: small squat globe with short narrow neck, layered dripping glaze bands, compact
Feel: vibrant, artisanal, playful
Goes with: walnut wood, white walls, earthy tones; mid-century or bohemian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid Century Modern Round Ceramic Home Decor Flower Vase - 5 Inch, Blue and Green
product.description: Varying shades of green and blue accentuate this ceramic vase, which acts as a lovely display piece with or without cut flowers. Each is fired with reactive glaze, so no two are alike. This vase will add refreshing color to any style room. 6"D x 6"W x 5.3"H Designed to hold cut flowers Ceramic stoneware Fired with reactive glaze; allow for variations in pattern and color
